name: AEGIS — Autonomous Pre-Trade Risk & Self-Monitoring Agent
description: Off-chain autonomous trading risk gate and reusable pre-trade evaluation service. Uses official OKX Agent Trade Kit (ATK) market observations, LAYA operational risk classification (CONTINUE/REVIEW/HALT), bounded EVREN reasoning, and deterministic fail-closed Python policy enforcement. On-chain ERC-8004 identity registration only; Python/LAYA/EVREN runtime executes off-chain.

aegisMetadata.note: Public endpoints array is intentionally empty until an agreed public HTTPS origin is verified. Do not infer on-chain model execution or live trading from ERC-8004 registration.
